content: CUPS lp printing pitfalls: default scaling uses the size embedded in the file; if no size is present the page may be scaled incorrectly. -o fit-to-page/-o scaling=100 controls image scaling; -o media= sets paper size; -o orientation-requested=4 for landscape; -o number-up=2|4|6|9|16 for N-up. Printer-specific options via lpoptions -p <printer> -l. A generated TIFF/PDF must carry correct density/units or output is mis-scaled.
